item.title: Infinite Minion Lifespan
item.description: Infinite Minion Lifespan is a Summon mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Removes minion despawn timers so summoned allies last forever. What it does Summoned minions never despawn on timers Turns summon builds into permanent armies Pairs with summon-focused armor sets How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe. Restart the game and enable the mod in the Mods menu.
